admin.theme.bounds.default.description: Description of a token field without bounds (font family, shadow, easing). {value} is the default (not translated).

admin.theme.bounds.duration.defaultMessage: 預設值：{value}。使用 ms 或 s，範圍為 {min}ms 到 {max}ms。
admin.theme.bounds.duration.description: Description of a duration token field.

admin.theme.bounds.length.defaultMessage: 預設值：{value}。使用 0 或 rem / px，範圍為 {min}rem 到 {max}rem。
admin.theme.bounds.length.description: Description of a length token field. {value} is the default, {min} and {max} numbers (not translated).

admin.theme.bounds.number.defaultMessage: 預設值：{value}。從 {min} 到 {max} 的數字。
admin.theme.bounds.number.description: Description of a number token field (line height).

admin.theme.color.dark.description: Visible label of the field of a color token's value in the dark theme, after the token name that only assistive technology reads ("color-accent Dark").

admin.theme.color.default.description: Description of a color field. {value} is the default color (not translated).

admin.theme.color.light.description: Visible label of the field of a color token's value in the light theme, after the token name that only assistive technology reads ("color-accent Light").

admin.theme.colors.description.defaultMessage: 每種顏色都有淺色與深色主題的值，格式為 #rrggbb；若預設值含透明度，則為 #rrggbbaa。文字與控制項必須與所在背景保持足夠的對比（WCAG 2.2 AA），因此變更一種顏色可能需要一併變更另一種。
admin.theme.colors.description.description: Description of the colors section of the theme screen.

admin.theme.colors.title.description: Heading of the section of the color tokens on the theme screen.

admin.theme.contrast.failing_dark.defaultMessage: 深色主題中，{bg} 上的 {fg} 對比為 {ratio}:1，需要 {minimum}:1。
admin.theme.contrast.failing_dark.description: A color pair below its minimum contrast in the dark theme. {fg} and {bg} are token names, {ratio} and {minimum} numbers (not translated).

admin.theme.contrast.failing_light.defaultMessage: 淺色主題中，{bg} 上的 {fg} 對比為 {ratio}:1，需要 {minimum}:1。
admin.theme.contrast.failing_light.description: A color pair below its minimum contrast in the light theme. {fg} and {bg} are token names, {ratio} and {minimum} numbers (not translated).

admin.theme.contrast.ok.defaultMessage: 在兩種主題中，所有文字與控制項的顏色都與其背景有足夠的對比（WCAG 2.2 AA）。
admin.theme.contrast.ok.description: Shown when every contrast pair of the theme meets its minimum.

admin.theme.contrast.title.description: Heading of the section that lists the color pairs below their minimum contrast on the theme screen.

admin.theme.css.description.defaultMessage: CSS 會加在權杖之後，套用到每個頁面。它在應用程式的內容安全政策（Content Security Policy）下執行，因此只能使用此伺服器上的圖片與字型。伺服器不會檢查其結果：對比、版面、焦點指示與由右至左的語言都由你負責，而類別名稱與頁面結構可能隨任何更新而改變。建議優先使用上方的權杖，它們會保持穩定。
admin.theme.css.description.description: Description of the custom CSS field: what the server does not guarantee.

admin.theme.css.label.description: Label of the custom CSS text area.

admin.theme.css.title.description: Heading of the custom CSS section of the theme screen.

admin.theme.description.defaultMessage: 主題會套用到所有訪客的網頁應用程式，以及登入等伺服器頁面，包含淺色與深色主題。已開啟的頁面會維持原本的外觀，直到重新載入；儲存的主題可能需要幾分鐘才會套用到所有人。欄位留空即保留預設值。

admin.theme.error.css_invalid.defaultMessage: 自訂 CSS 不是有效的文字。
admin.theme.error.css_invalid.description: Reason a theme is refused: the custom CSS is not UTF-8 or contains NUL.

admin.theme.error.css_too_long.defaultMessage: 自訂 CSS 最多只能有 {max} 位元組。
admin.theme.error.css_too_long.description: Reason a theme is refused: the custom CSS is too long. {max} is a number of bytes.

admin.theme.error.duplicate_token.description: Reason a theme is refused: the token appears twice.

admin.theme.error.invalid_dark.defaultMessage: 深色主題中的 {token} 不是有效的顏色。
admin.theme.error.invalid_dark.description: Reason a theme is refused: the dark value of a color token is not #rrggbb.

admin.theme.error.invalid_light.defaultMessage: 淺色主題中的 {token} 不是有效的顏色。
admin.theme.error.invalid_light.description: Reason a theme is refused: the light value of a color token is not #rrggbb.

admin.theme.error.invalid_value.description: Reason a theme is refused: a non-color token's value has the wrong form.

admin.theme.error.out_of_range.defaultMessage: {token} 必須介於 {min} 到 {max} 之間。
admin.theme.error.out_of_range.description: Reason a theme is refused: a value is outside its bounds. {min} and {max} are numbers, rem for lengths and ms for durations (not translated).

admin.theme.error.unknown_token.description: Reason a theme is refused: the token is not overridable. {token} is a token name (not translated).

admin.theme.preview.button.description: Sample primary button text in the theme preview.

admin.theme.preview.danger.description: Sample error text in the theme preview.

admin.theme.preview.description.defaultMessage: 依輸入的權杖，以本頁目前的主題顯示。自訂 CSS 不會預覽。

admin.theme.preview.heading.description: Sample heading in the theme preview.

admin.theme.preview.link.description: Sample link text in the theme preview.

admin.theme.preview.muted.defaultMessage: 次要文字：時間、帳號名稱與提示
admin.theme.preview.muted.description: Sample secondary text in the theme preview.

admin.theme.preview.text.description: Sample body text in the theme preview.

admin.theme.preview.title.description: Heading of the preview of the theme being edited.

admin.theme.save_failed.description: Error when saving the theme failed for another reason. {reason} is the localized cause.

admin.theme.save_refused.description: Lead-in of the list of reasons the server refused the theme.

admin.theme.saved.defaultMessage: 主題已儲存。訪客下次載入頁面時就會套用，最多需要幾分鐘。
admin.theme.saved.description: Status after the theme was saved.

admin.theme.summary.defaultMessage: 所有人使用的網頁應用程式的顏色、字體、間距與自訂 CSS
admin.theme.summary.description: Description of the theme screen's link in the admin menu.

admin.theme.title.description: Title of the admin screen that sets the instance theme (design token overrides and custom CSS), and its link in the admin menu.

admin.theme.tokens.description.defaultMessage: 字型、文字大小與行高、間距單位、圓角、陰影（高度）以及動態效果的時間長度與緩動。超出權杖範圍的值不會儲存；伺服器不會檢查應用程式套用這些值後的外觀。
admin.theme.tokens.description.description: Description of the section of the non-color tokens on the theme screen.

admin.theme.tokens.title.description: Heading of the section of the tokens other than colors on the theme screen.
